data.signal_sensors: Client sensors (Wi-Fi signal, IP address, person, roams)

data_description.scan_interval: How often the router is polled. Default 300 seconds (5 minutes); minimum 30.
data_description.consider_home: How long a client stays home after it was last seen. Never shorter than the polling interval. Default 600 seconds.
data_description.signal_sensors: Manual: enable each sensor yourself. Follow tracker: a client's sensors are enabled while its device tracker is enabled. All: every client gets enabled sensors. Sensors you disabled yourself are never re-enabled.

router_unreachable.title: Movistar router unreachable
router_unreachable.description: The last {failures} polls of the router failed ({error}). Device trackers use their presence grace period until the router answers again. Check that the router is on and reachable from Home Assistant. This notice clears automatically after the next successful poll.
